in_marathi.name: Revaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Revaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Revaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravana', which means 'mighty' or 'powerful'. In Hindu mythology, Ravana is known as the king of Lanka and the demon king who abducted Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. Despite his negative portrayal in the epic Ramayana, he is also revered as a powerful and intelligent figure.
